about: ASEAN Watch real-data snapshot written by scripts/refresh-data.mjs. Records are real; nothing is simulated. Anomalies are decided by the stated watch rules in src/lib/watchRules.ts, not here.

collection.note: Rows were kept within these distances of each volcano summit point, or inside each haze box, and inside the window. The watch rules use smaller radii and drop the rest. Inside a haze box at most hazeKeepPerSatelliteDay rows per satellite per UTC day are kept, highest fire radiative power first; firms.json hazeDayTotals counts every row of a satellite-day over that limit (rowsCountedNotKept per FIRMS file).
